comment: Drills the tap drill (the modelled bore) with chip breaking (G73) every 1 x the drill's diameter, from 3 to 5 x its diameter deep. Starter template generated by tools/gen_library.py (task T-057): rules and numbers chosen by that script as conservative generic starting points, not copied from any table; compare with Machinery's Handbook (Industrial Press), 'Drilling' and 'Tapping'. Check them against your machine, tools and material before relying on them.
name: Tap drill, chip break
